title: From a public archive to a locked verdict
subtitle: A straight line of stages, plus two scripts that carry the protocol. Click a stage for details.

steps.name: data.binance.vision
steps.role: Public archive, all USDT spot pairs including delisted ones

steps.name: one parquet
steps.role: 27,721 monthly zips merged into one file

steps.name: load_panel()
steps.role: Long panel of date, symbol, OHLC and quote volume. The only entry point to the data

steps.name: build_dataset(panel, end=...)
steps.role: Truncates at end first, then builds everything else
details: split_relistings turns LUNAUSDT into LUNAUSDT#2 after a gap of more than 7 days
to_wide builds date × symbol frames on a gap-free daily index
9 raw features, each using rows up to t only
cs_rank, centered ranks in [−0.5, 0.5] among members

steps.name: long frame (date, symbol)
steps.role: Members only, with 9 ranked features, fwd_ret and y_rank

steps.name: forecast (date, symbol)
steps.role: Per fold, fit on dates up to test_start − 6 days

outputs.name: daily_ic
outputs.role: Mean IC, Newey-West t, hit rate

steps.name: backtest(weights, fwd_ret)
steps.role: Gross returns and turnover, so any cost level is one subtraction
details: net at any cost c = gross − turnover · c

steps.name: summarize
steps.role: Sharpe, PSR, drawdown and the cost grid

cards.name: run_dev.py
cards.role: Cuts data at 2024-06-30 and runs 18 trials on 9 folds

cards.name: run_holdout.py
details: Refuses if LOCK.json exists, then writes the lock
Records the verdicts in the lock
